title: A committed lock file stops every build on CI
goal: A lock file that only means something on the machine someone is playtesting on is checked into the repository, so the build machine finds it too and refuses to build the app. Every run on the build machine has failed at that step since it was committed, and a release would fail the same way. The lock should only ever exist on the machine that made it.
notes:
Reproduced on CI run 34716668729 (main, e5462576), step "Build release app bundle":

  Run Scripts/build-app.sh
  !! Refusing to rebuild "dist/Photonz Dev.app": a playtest is in progress (queue/playtest.lock).
  ##[error]Process completed with exit code 2.

Confirmed tracked: `git ls-files queue/playtest.lock` prints the path, and .gitignore has no playtest entry. The file has been in the tree since 2026-08-23.

This is the same shape of problem as the perf-gate task: .github/workflows/release.yml runs Scripts/build-app.sh in its "Build app" step, so a release would die there for a reason that has nothing to do with the release. Fix is `git rm --cached queue/playtest.lock` plus a .gitignore entry; check whether queue/bin/*.sh expects the file to be tracked before removing it.
acceptance: queue/playtest.lock is no longer tracked by git and is ignored, so a fresh checkout never has one
A CI run on main gets past the Build release app bundle step
The lock still does its job locally: with the file present, Scripts/build-app.sh refuses to rebuild the dev app

log.note: Adversarial review before touching anything. The untrack half of this task already landed in f2d321a2, done by hand from the intake window: queue/playtest.lock is out of the index and .gitignore line 16 covers it, so acceptance 1 was already true when I claimed this. Checked that nothing wants it tracked - the only readers are the guard in Scripts/build-app.sh and prose in CLAUDE.md, queue/bin/runner-prompt.md and the run-app skill. Nothing in queue/bin reads the file.

Acceptance 2 was NOT true, because a second failure was hiding behind the first. Run 34740281542 (the fix commit) got past the guard - the log reads "==> Building Photonz 0.15.0 (dev, arm64)" where it used to read "Refusing to rebuild" - and died anyway. The step created the Photonz Dev self-signed cert on the runner, printed "==> Codesigning (stable self-signed: Photonz Dev)" at 05:38:54, and sat there until the 25 minute job timeout killed it at 05:51:18. A just-imported private key makes codesign ask the keychain for permission with a dialog, and on a headless runner nobody answers it. Not an error, a hang.

Third thing the log gave away: the step is called "Build release app bundle" but ran the bare script, which selects the DEV variant, so it was building dist/Photonz Dev.app while the upload step asked for dist/Photonz.app and quietly got nothing (upload-artifact only warns by default). The same shape sits in release.yml: its Build app step is bare too, so if APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY is ever unset a release builds the dev bundle and the later --dmg-only step finds no dist/Photonz.app. All three fixed here, because acceptance 2 asks for a step that passes, not one that merely gets past the lock.
